comparison.objective: Flex a 3D-printer build plate to release a printed part and place both safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual symmetric bending within curvature limits, catch/transfer of the released part, and plate replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Part freed into bin, plate returned flat and released; kinking, dropping, or unsafe deflection fails.
comparison.reason: Although both use two-handed tool handling, controlled elastic flexure and part release are not aperture-mediated granular separation.
